text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Gimlet. What was that this morning? 
Leaving an omelet rice by my pillow out of 
nowhere.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Today is the nativity of the 
monster who wears the Triple Crown. Such a 
celebration ought to commence with an 
exquisite breakfast.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Thus, a dish from our memories. From the 
day you sisters visited Father's temple— I 
have recreated the omurice we shared in 
our youth.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Have you truly bathed in the river of 
oblivion? The young lion was especially 
enchanted by that dish, yet... Heh, it 
brings back fond memories...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what on earth are you talking 
about?

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I simply meant that it must have been a 
nostalgic taste for you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
—Ah, indeed. It certainly had a strangely 
nostalgic taste to it.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Did you drown in the whispers of the God 
of Dreams? I hope your tastes haven't 
changed.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? ...Well, I don't really get it, 
but it was tasty. I'll thank you for that 
much, at least.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Affection seems to overflow within 
me, Brian. My heart just skipped a beat.
